title: CDSFL experimental archive: raw multi-model review transcripts, 2026
description:
Raw experimental material from the CDSFL project (Constraint-Driven Synthesis and Falsification), a research framework for improving large language model reliability on scientific and technical work.

In CDSFL, a panel of models from different vendors independently reviews a target document and raises findings against it. A finding rated critical is resolved only when the accusing model supplies a runnable falsifier — a small program designed to fail if and only if the defect is real — which the framework then re-executes itself. A model's prose verdict resolves nothing.

This archive holds the primary source material generated by those runs: the complete unedited output of every model in every round, together with run checkpoints, diagnostic shadow traces and append-only logs. Approximately 340 MB across 5,760 files, organised by run directory so that any path cited in the project's notes resolves inside the archive unchanged.

The distilled experimental record — per-run final reports and runner state, carrying the finding registries, the falsifiers and the verdicts — is NOT in this archive. It remains in the source repository, because evidence requiring a separate download is evidence most readers will not consult. This archive is the material underneath that record.

KNOWN LIMITATION, stated because it affects replication: each per-model record stores the model's response and the character length of the prompt it received, but not the prompt text itself. Prompts are reconstructible from the directives, targets and configuration held in the source repository, but they were not recorded at the time.
